title: Accept the difficult sweetness of Hukam
summary: This source admits that speaking is easy while accepting Hukam is difficult. Tell the truth like a child, then practice receiving the Will you cannot manage.
takeaway: Tell the truth like a child, then practice accepting the Will you cannot manage.
lifeApplication: When you want to argue with what happened, begin with one honest childlike sentence before the Beloved and ask to accept one piece of it cleanly.

source.shortMeaning: The child can admit mistakes before the Merciful One, even while accepting Hukam remains difficult.
source.lifeApplication: Bring resistance into honest prayer instead of dressing it as control.

evidence.coreClaim: The child can admit mistakes before the Merciful One, even while accepting Hukam remains difficult.
evidence.turn: The shabad holds mercy and difficulty together: confession becomes possible before the Will that cannot be mastered.
evidence.practicalImplication: When you want to argue with what happened, begin with one honest childlike sentence before the Beloved and ask to accept one piece of it cleanly.
